faces.name: Ikori-All-You-Can-Eat
faces.oracleText:
When you planeswalk here and at the beginning of your upkeep, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a non-Human creature card. Put that card into your hand. It perpetually gains mutate {4}. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
Whenever chaos ensues, destroy all Humans. They can't be regenerated.
